TAHSIL  HUZUR DISTRICT REWA (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI JITENDRA PRASAD GAUTAM - ADVOCATE )

AND  DEEPAK KHARE S/O MAHESH KHARE, AGED ABOUT 30  YEARS, OCCUPATION: BUSINESS R/O. LAHRI NAGAR  BAIHAR ROAD DISTRICT BALAGHAT (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 .
 (BY SHRI SAJIDULLA KHAN - ADVOCATE)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER
This is first application on behalf of the applicant under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail.

Applicant is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No./RCT No. 1042/2021 cognizable by the First Additional Sessions Judge, Balaghat for the offence punishable under Sections 420,
406, 409, 468, 471, 120-B of the Indian Penal Code.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the allegation against the present applicant is that he was running a Company who is in the business of taking money from customers/investors with an assurance that their amount will be repaid with a higher rate of interest.
However, on depositing the amount and not getting proper return, a complaint has been made.

Learned counsel for the respondent submits that not only the respondent but there are other persons who have also deposited the amount with the applicant but they did not get adequate returns on the said amount and, therefore, they made a complaint to the police and finally complaint case was filed before the Court and offence got registered and as such, present applicant made accused in the said complaint case.
Learned counsel for the applicant also submits that one of the co- accused namely Ajijurrehman has been granted bail by this Court who was also facing similar allegation on the ground that before the Court it was stated that negotiations between the parties was going on and, therefore, considering the said aspect, bail application was considered.

He submits that present applicant deposited Rs. 5,500/- only but on a complaint made to the Superintendent of Police, the hypothetical allegations made against the present applicant and other persons showing that they have deposited huge amount with the Company running by the present applicant but that allegation was not correct and only on the basis of hypothetical assessment,
complaint has been made against him.

He submits that complaint case is going on and, therefore,
applicant may be allowed to participate in the proceedings, in case, he appears before the Court below, he may not be arrested.

Considering the aforesaid and taking note of the fact that co-accused has already been granted bail by this Court, this application is disposed of directing the applicant to appear before the Court below where the case is being tried.

It is directed that if the applicant appears before the Court below, he shall not be arrested and in case, any such situation arises, the bail bond furnished by the applicant may be considered and he be allowed to participate in the proceedings.

It is further directed that in the event of arrest, applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing a bail bond in the sum of Rs. 1,00,000/- (Rupees one lakh only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Station House Officer/Arresting Officer of the Police Station concerned.
The applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
Certified copy as per rules.
